voltage_domain_warnings.description: Dualgate (55/0) marks gf180mcu's 5V/6V thick-oxide voltage domain. This curated deck models it for the DF.1a/DF.3a COMP width/space rules and (issue #1111) MOS device recognition/model binding (nfet_06v0/pfet_06v0 under --pdk) only; every other DRC rule still applies the 3.3V/_LV thresholds regardless of Dualgate's presence (e.g. DF.6 COMP extend beyond gate 0.24 vs. 0.40, PL.5a/PL.5b field poly to COMP 0.10 vs. 0.30 -- all in um, and neither transcribed in this deck yet).
